operatingIdea: Protect independent searches, attack each candidate, then synthesize by evidence.
bestFor: Problems where different representations or evidence streams can be explored independently before cross-pollination.
produces: A synthesized solution selected by correctness and evidence, plus the strongest rejected alternative and why it failed.
antiUseCases: Do not use when workstreams cannot be made genuinely independent or synthesis cost dominates.
representativeRequest: Use Independent Discovery and Adversarial Synthesis to multi-hypothesis research with explicit evidence and acceptance gates.
applicabilityGate: Use only when at least two genuinely distinct, substantive routes can address the same literal objective.
Require a common evidence, authority, constraint, and acceptance basis that makes route results comparable.
Route away when independent search cannot be sustained or synthesis cost is disproportionate to the decision.
solExecutionContract: Bind one literal objective, evidence set, authority boundary, constraints, and acceptance basis that every candidate route must share.

Create at least two substantive independent candidates that differ in representation, mechanism, method, or governing insight, each with enough provenance and checkable work to yield a comparable result rather than wording variation.
Keep candidates isolated through their first strong result; maintain an approach registry and redirect duplication toward underexplored routes.
If fewer than two substantive comparable candidates can be produced from the common evidence, return SYNTHESIS_BLOCKED with the exact missing evidence or route and do not fabricate plurality.
Assign an adversarial challenge to every serious candidate covering assumptions, transformations, boundaries, circularity, source support, failure conditions, and conflicts with common evidence.

Revise or eliminate candidates from evidence; never choose by consensus, confidence, elegance, or an aggregate formula unless every dimension, scale, normalization, and weight is explicitly defined and evidence-justified.

Synthesize only compatible surviving components through claim-evidence mapping, leaving incompatible components separate, and report the decisive insight, verification, uncertainty, and strongest rejected alternative.
observableOutputContract: Common evidence, authority, constraint, objective, and acceptance packet
At least two substantive independent candidate dossiers with provenance and checkable results
Adversarial challenge and elimination ledger plus synthesis compatibility matrix
Evidence-mapped synthesis, or a SYNTHESIS_BLOCKED packet naming the missing evidence or route
failureAndAdversarialChecklist: Reject requirement loss, unsupported claims, fabricated evidence, or unapproved authority expansion.
Test boundary cases, counterexamples, failure modes, and the strongest plausible rejected alternative.
Require observable acceptance evidence and state unresolved uncertainty explicitly.
Do not use when workstreams cannot be made genuinely independent or synthesis cost dominates.

profileAdaptations.single: One Sol agent owns synthesis and uses independent internal passes without claiming nonexistent agents.
profileAdaptations.multi: Delegate only genuinely independent bounded workstreams; preserve provenance, handoffs, integration tests, and root synthesis.
profileAdaptations.ultra: Production Ultra uses full_approved_capsule semantics only after a signed and verified native capability attestation and user authorization bind the canonical capsule, complete budget, kill switch, and lease policy plus branch termination and root acceptance; proof_only is a development and validation mode, never the production default.
